name: Image Text Carousel for Elementor
author: Praveen M

sections.description:
Image Text Carousel for Elementor is a lightweight and easy-to-use Elementor widget that allows you to create beautiful image and text sliders inside your WordPress website.

With this plugin, you can design fully customizable carousels that include images, titles, descriptions, buttons, and links — all directly from the Elementor editor.

Perfect for:
– Testimonials
– Featured services
– Team members
– Portfolio highlights
– Product showcases
– Hero sliders

The widget is fully responsive and works seamlessly with all Elementor-compatible themes.

Features

  • Custom Image + Text carousel widget for Elementor
  • Add unlimited carousel items
  • Title, description, and button support
  • Custom link option for each slide
  • Fully responsive design
  • Easy styling controls (colors, typography, spacing)
  • Navigation arrows and dots control
  • Autoplay option
  • Lightweight and optimized code
  • No coding required

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open any page with Elementor.
  3. Search for “Image Text Carousel”.
  4. Drag and drop the widget into your section.
  5. Add images, text, and customize styles as needed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Open Elementor Editor → Search “Image Text Carousel”

Or install manually:

  1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through the WordPress Plugins menu
  3. Use the widget inside Elementor editor
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor must be installed and activated.

Does it work with Elementor Free?

Yes, it works with the free version of Elementor.

Is the carousel responsive?

Yes, it is fully responsive and works on mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

Can I customize colors and typography?

Yes, styling options are available inside the Elementor widget controls.

Does it slow down the website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.
